name: kv-store
title: Key Value Store
description: Store key-value pairs in categories and copy values from Raycast or the menu bar.
author: georgy_s

commands.name: kv
commands.title: Search Key Values
commands.description: Create, organize, search, and copy local key-value pairs.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Key Values in Menu Bar
commands.description: Browse categorized keys in the menu bar and copy their values.

scripts.lint: eslint src && prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js src README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.fix-lint: eslint src --fix && prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js src README.md CHANGELOG.md
